Diamond shape refers to `the geometric outline of a stone when viewed from above, divided into the classic round brilliant and various "fancy" shapes`.[[1]](https://www.tiffany.com/engagement/diamond-education/diamond-shapes.html)

### Popular Diamond Shapes

- **Round Brilliant:** The most popular and traditional choice, offering maximum sparkle and fire.[[1]](https://www.bluenile.com/education/diamonds/shape)[[2]](https://www.tiffany.com/engagement/diamond-education/diamond-shapes.html)
- **Oval:** An elongated take on the round cut that maximizes perceived size and slims the finger.[[1]](https://4cs.gia.edu/en-us/blog/guide-diamond-shapes-engagement-rings/)[[2]](https://www.kay.com/different-diamond-shapes)
- **Princess:** A square or rectangular shape with sharp corners delivering modern brilliance.[[1]](https://4cs.gia.edu/en-us/blog/guide-diamond-shapes-engagement-rings/)
- **Cushion:** A square or rectangular shape with rounded corners and pillow-like curves.[[1]](https://www.kay.com/different-diamond-shapes)
- **Emerald:** A rectangular step-cut stone with cropped corners and a clear "hall of mirrors" visual effect.[[1]](https://4cs.gia.edu/en-us/blog/guide-diamond-shapes-engagement-rings/)
- **Pear:** A teardrop shape combining a rounded end with a sharp, singular point.[[1]](https://4cs.gia.edu/en-us/blog/guide-diamond-shapes-engagement-rings/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:8339284427675629624,catalogid:8196455263640016141,gpcid:2703070341996965134,mid:576462873302695337&ibp=oshop)
- **Marquise:** A dramatic, elongated hull shape with pointed ends that offers great surface coverage per carat.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/glJOyD37xKQ)
- **Radiant:** A hybrid style combining the clean geometric lines of a rectangle/square with brilliant-cut faceting.[[1]](https://4cs.gia.edu/en-us/blog/guide-diamond-shapes-engagement-rings/)
- **Asscher:** A step-cut square with deep-cut corners and concentric square facets.[[1]](https://4cs.gia.edu/en-us/blog/guide-diamond-shapes-engagement-rings/)
- **Heart:** An unmistakable symbol of romance featuring an indented cleft and a pointed base.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P8gdsCgpD1w&t=66)[[2]](https://www.frankadams.com/journals/shapes-of-diamonds-a-complete-guide-to-popular-and-unique-diamond-shapes)

If you want to narrow down your choices, tell me:

- **What type of jewelry** are you shopping for (engagement ring, pendant, earrings)?
- Do you prefer **maximum sparkle** (brilliant cut) or a **clear, elegant gleam** (step cut)?
- Do you have a **target carat weight or budget** in mind?
